claims.statement: Team-linking guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES; organization owners or people with both team-maintainer role and project admin can add project to team. One of maintainer/admin alone does not satisfy documented combined condition.
Adding project to team grants collaborator read permission and lists it on team Projects page. Unlike repository listing, this linkage changes project access, not discoverability alone.
Read grant is additive to existing team/individual project permissions and retains higher roles. Linking must not be interpreted as downgrade to Read or proof effective least privilege.
UI prompts confirmation if team-member project permissions increase. Prompt or confirmation is not estate approval, effective access verification or guarantee all increased-access paths identified.

Remove procedure uses project Manage access and removes team. Removal of that grant does not prove all team members lose access through individual grants, base role, owner status, other teams or public/internal visibility.
Project read grant does not confer underlying private-repository item permissions. Team membership/project association must remain separate from repository grants and actual reader behavior.

Source provides no exhaustive owner-scope or recovery matrix beyond procedure. No team linked, permission granted/removed or native test performed; claims remain reference-only pending policy, rights and rollout evidence.
